description: Isolated local diagnostic profile: monthly schedules starting August 2026, business day 2026-10-25; RUB/USD/EUR, five categories, paid history, 5% archived, 2% removed, 5% October pauses. HTTP contract validation and password hashing are excluded from measured request timings. No live external sends.
limitations: Short finite samples, not a sustained capacity/SLA claim; p95 is nearest-rank on 12 requests.
HTTP timings include loopback transport and JSON serialization, but no browser rendering or WAN latency.
Memory is sampled Go heap for the test process (server and HTTP client together), not production RSS.
Queue transport sleeps a controlled 20 ms per message; it does not model Telegram rate limits, SMTP or real network failures.
Only two queue passes are measured; remaining backlog is reported, not extrapolated to a delivery-time promise.
